d:
Taarak Mehta scrambles to office after taking leave under the pretext of an ancestral land court case in Pune. When his suspicious boss demands his lawyer’s contact, Taarak turns to Bagha, who poses as hot-tempered advocate "Bageshwar LLB" over a burner phone, bluntly lecturing the boss and saving Taarak's job. In retaliation, the boss piles a mountain of pending files on Taarak with terrible tea.
Are you ready for the challenge?
